name: field
body: A template field definition: name, type, rules (required, default, max_length — characters after Markdown stripping, min/max_items, min/max, plain, description), display formats for number/date (input is always a plain YAML number / `YYYY-MM-DD`). A required field that declares a default is satisfied when omitted — the default is applied — everywhere a `fields` map is validated (slide and section instances, template examples and `section` helper calls; field-rules). A `fields` map supplied to the `section` helper is checked against the target's field schema by the same rules (section-helper).
